interpretation: x64 B8 imm32 C3 is mov eax, imm32; ret. RocksDB.Version.fromEncodedVersion decodes bits 16..23/8..15/0..7 as major/minor/patch.
limitations: Static inspection of the exact pinned DLL only; no JNI load or database access.

Loaded-module identity and the actual runtime-returned tuple remain separate execution evidence.
